items.title: Updated: Sustainability leadership moves
items.summary: As corporate sustainability matures, some long-time leaders are leaving the profession, while others are tackling a broader set of responsibilities following reorganizations or layoffs.

items.title: Updated: Sustainability tools to use in 2026

items.title: On and New Balance join project to improve footwear’s environmental supply chain data
items.summary: # On and New Balance join project to improve footwear’s environmental supply chain data Fashion for Good has partnered with footwear brands including On and New Balance to build environmental datasets from primary supplier data that can be shared across the sector.

items.title: Household heat pump applications reached record heights in October
items.summary: # Household heat pump applications reached record heights in October The number of households applying for heat pump grants hit a record high in October, as demand skyrockets due to the cost of energy bills.

items.title: Unilever trials plant-based feedstock for detergents in China
items.summary: # Unilever trials plant-based feedstock for detergents in China Unilever is trialling plant-based compounds in its OMO Wonder Wash bottles in China in a bid to reduce its reliance on fossil carbon in cleaning products.

items.title: Transition planning: Businesses at risk from ‘ambition-action gap’ for climate resilience
items.summary: # Transition planning: Businesses at risk from ‘ambition-action gap’ for climate resilience After a Super El Niño year of extreme heat, flash floods and droughts, climate resilience has become the strongest reported driver of business action on nature, according to a new from .

items.title: Carbon without borders: The UK-EU ‘landmark’ deal and what comes next
items.summary: # Carbon without borders: The UK-EU ‘landmark’ deal and what comes next The recent UK-EU ETS linking agreement aims to close the gap between compliance emissions markets, while the broader global voluntary market remains oversupplied and distrusted.

items.title: Apply now: Entries open for the edie Awards 2027
items.summary: # Apply now: Entries open for the edie Awards 2027 The UK’s largest corporate sustainability awards scheme is celebrating its 20th year with a restructured programme, built around three pillars and new categories including AI, water and adaptation.

items.title: Bridging the value delivery gap: Why corporate climate action needs operational overhaul
items.summary: # Bridging the value delivery gap: Why corporate climate action needs operational overhaul Decarbonisation stalls when it’s treated as a sustainability project rather than an investment decision, argues South Pole’s Global Head of Advisory Dara Olufon, as new research finds only 23% of firms consistently win CFO backing for climate business cases.

items.title: 樹怎麼種才對？ 工程會發布指引 綠化須獨立預算、從設計到養護全納入
items.summary: 大種樹時代來臨？在極端氣候挑戰下，綠化已成為重要的調適措施，但要如何正確種樹？行政院公共工程委員會發布「公共工程植生綠化作業原則指引」，要求公共工程重視植栽綠化，必須從設計階段開始全生命週期納入樹木的種植與維護。主委陳金德表示，未來基本設計審查將檢視綠化計畫及獨立編列的預算，未提出者可以退回。
